caseName: Smalls v. Atlantic Coast Line Railroad
caseNameFull: Smalls v. Atlantic Coast Line Railroad Co.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is reversed.

Mr. Justice Reed, Mr. Justice Burton, and Mr. Justice Minton dissent.
